cards.ex: My band is playing a gig at the local pub next Friday.
cards.exUz: Mening guruhim kelasi juma kuni mahalliy pabda konsert beradi.
cards.uzDef: Musiqachi yoki guruhning omma oldida chiqish qilishi, konsert berishi.

cards.ex: The singer's emotional performance really hit the right note with the audience.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqchining hissiy ijrosi tomoshabinlarga juda yoqdi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'l tutmoq, maqsadga erishmoq yoki kimgadir yoqish.

cards.ex: The young dancer completely stole the show with her amazing talent.
cards.exUz: Yosh raqqosa o'zining ajoyib iste'dodi bilan tomoshani butunlay o'g'irladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra yaxshiroq chiqish qilib, barcha e'tiborni jalb qilish.

cards.ex: The play received a standing ovation on its opening night.
cards.exUz: Pyesa premyera kechasida tik turib olqishlandi.
cards.uzDef: Ijroni juda yuqori baholab, odamlarning tik turib qarsak chalishi.

cards.ex: After Beyoncé's incredible performance, the next act had a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Beyonsening ajoyib chiqishidan so'ng, keyingi ijrochi uchun vazifa qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir muvaffaqiyatidan keyin ularning darajasiga yetish qiyin bo'lgan vazifa.

cards.ex: The comedian couldn't read the room and his jokes fell flat.
cards.exUz: Komik vaziyatni tushuna olmadi va hazillari muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning kayfiyatini tushunish va shunga mos ravishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I always get stage fright before a big performance.
cards.exUz: Katta chiqishdan oldin men har doim sahna qo'rquviga tushaman.
cards.uzDef: Sahna oldida asabiylashish, hayajonlanish holati.

cards.ex: The DJ dropped the beat and the crowd went wild.
cards.exUz: DJ ritmni boshladi va olomon hayajonga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Musiqada ritmni kiritish yoki boshlash.

cards.ex: The dancers need to be in tune with the music to perform well.
cards.exUz: Raqqosalar yaxshi ijro etish uchun musiqa bilan mos bo'lishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bilan mos kelish, bir xil fikrda bo'lish, hamohang bo'lish.

cards.ex: The director calls the shots during the rehearsals.
cards.exUz: Rejissor repetitsiyalar paytida qarorlar qabul qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni boshqarish, qarorlar qabul qilish.

cards.ex: After years in the band, she decided to go solo.
cards.exUz: Guruhda yillar davomida bo'lganidan so'ng, u yakka chiqishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Guruhdan ajralib, yakka o'zi ijro etishni boshlash.

cards.ex: He knew he had to face the music for skipping rehearsals.
cards.exUz: U repetitsiyalarni o'tkazib yuborgani uchun javob berishi kerakligini bilar edi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlar uchun javobgarlikka tortilish.

cards.ex: The band played to a sell-out crowd at the stadium.
cards.exUz: Guruh stadionda to'la tomoshabinga ijro etdi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha chiptalar sotilgan va zal to'la bo'lgan tomoshabin.

cards.ex: Some pop stars lip sync during their performances.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi pop yulduzlari chiqishlari paytida lablarini qo'shiqqa moslashtiradilar.
cards.uzDef: Fonogrammada kuylash, lablarni qo'shiq bilan moslashtirish.

cards.ex: The band is currently on tour across Europe.
cards.exUz: Guruh hozirda Yevropa bo'ylab gastrol safarida.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta shaharlarda chiqish qilish uchun safarda bo'lish.

cards.ex: We didn't rehearse the ending, so we'll just have to play it by ear.
cards.exUz: Biz yakunni repetitsiya qilmadik, shuning uchun biz uni vaziyatga qarab hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Rejasiz, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilish, improvizatsiya qilish.

cards.ex: Her final song really brought down the house.
cards.exUz: Uning so'nggi qo'shig'i haqiqatan ham zalni olqishlarga ko'mib tashladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda muvaffaqiyatli chiqish qilib, olqishga sazovor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I started to tune out during the long guitar solo.
cards.exUz: Men uzun gitara solosi paytida diqqatimni yo'qota boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni yo'qotish, eshitmaslik yoki e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: A new generation of actors is waiting in the wings.
cards.exUz: Aktyorlarning yangi avlodi imkoniyatni kutmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z navbatini kutish, imkoniyatni kutish.

cards.ex: I got a backstage pass to meet the band after the show.
cards.exUz: Konsertdan so'ng guruh bilan uchrashish uchun sahna ortiga ruxsatnoma oldim.
cards.uzDef: Sahna ortiga kirish huquqini beruvchi ruxsatnoma.

cards.ex: The audience cheered so loudly that the band gave an encore performance.
cards.exUz: Tomoshabinlar shunchalik baland qarsak chalishdi, guruh qo'shimcha chiqish qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlar talabi bilan qo'shimcha ijro etiladigan chiqish.

cards.ex: The singer needs to warm up their vocal cords before the show.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqchi konsertdan oldin ovoz paychalarini qizdirishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mashq qilish, tayyorgarlik ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: The concert was so popular, it was standing room only.
cards.exUz: Konsert juda mashhur edi, faqat turishga joy bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha o'rindiqlar band, faqat turishga joy bor.

cards.ex: The concert sold out in just a few hours.
cards.exUz: Konsert chiptalari bir necha soat ichida sotilib tugadi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha chiptalarni sotib tugatish.

cards.ex: She's a natural on stage; she was born to perform.
cards.exUz: U sahnada tug'ma iste'dodga ega; u chiqish qilish uchun tug'ilgan.
cards.uzDef: O'z sohasida tug'ma iste'dodga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's been in the spotlight ever since she won the competition.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada g'alaba qozonganidan beri diqqat markazida.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy e'tibor markazida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The comedian struggled; it was a tough crowd.
cards.exUz: Komik kurashdi; talabchan tomoshabin edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin rozi bo'ladigan, talabchan tomoshabinlar guruhi.

cards.ex: The band members are always on the same wavelength when they perform.
cards.exUz: Guruh a'zolari ijro etish paytida har doim bir xil fikrda bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta narsani tushunish, bir xil fikrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's an up-and-coming singer with a lot of potential.
cards.exUz: U kelajagi porloq, rivojlanayotgan qo'shiqchi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajagi porloq, rivojlanayotgan (masalan, ijrochi).

cards.ex: Break a leg tonight! I know you'll do great.
cards.exUz: Bugun omad tilayman! Men bilaman, siz a'lo darajada ijro etasiz.
cards.uzDef: Omad tilash iborasi, ayniqsa chiqish oldidan ishlatiladi.
